text:
Emily (CSM): Heads up — GarnetRetail usage dropped ~72% WoW for inference endpoints. Customer reports more errors and 'responses less relevant' since last Tue. Olivia (CTO) left; procurement paused. Can we triage?

Raj (Account Exec): Noted. Do we have recent onboarding or model changes on their account? Any billing anomalies? Paging Lina for an infra/SE check.

ops-bot: alert: repeated fallback triggers detected for customer_id=garnet-834; recent window 2026-03-18 03:10–03:14 UTC, model-version:v2.1 fallback count=14, 429 spikes=22.

Lina (SE): I pulled logs — no deploys from our side for that account. They're on hosted API. Traffic shows larger ratio of cold starts and a drop in prefix cache hits (from 86% -> 21%). Also seeing a handful of requests with referrer header hinting at "nimbus.ai" — possible competitive PoC.

Mateo (CS Ops): I'll extract token usage and billing trend for last 45 days and a 7-day rolling comparison. FYI procurement contact changed in our CRM export: alex@garretrtl.com -> procurement@garretrtl.com.

Emily (CSM): Proposed next steps: 1) short sync w/ new ML lead (Jamie) to understand priorities and prompts, 2) offer a 2-week Dedicated trial + migration support to stabilize latencies, 3) run a small eval harness comparing their top 20 prompts vs Nimbus (if they're evaluating). Who can own what?

Raj (Account Exec): I'll own the commercial outreach and trial offer. I'll include a targeted success SLA and discount for dedicated capacity.

Lina (SE): I'll own the technical eval + quick perf snapshot. Plan: run p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost delta with quantized variant, and prefix cache recommendation. Need a sample prompt set and a short window of recent request IDs.

Mateo (CS Ops): I'll produce the usage slice (last 30/7/1 days), error breakdown (429/5xx/ aborted), and recent rollout/rollback events. Deliverable by EOD tomorrow.

Emily (CSM): I'll schedule a 30-min call with Jamie for Thursday 10am PT and ask them to share 10–20 representative prompts and any internal eval criteria. Also capturing the feedback line: "responses less accurate last 2 weeks" for our QA regression check.

Raj (Account Exec): Great — I'll draft the trial T&Cs and include fallback routing options in the offer. @Lina can you post the minimal commands we need to run the harness?

Lina (SE): Sure — example curl to repro a failing request:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED' \
  -d '{"model":"garnet-retail-2.1","prompt":"<sample>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Send me 5 sample request IDs and I'll scope the eval.

Emily (CSM): On it. I'll ping Jamie and procurement@garretrtl.com after this thread. Putting a quick risk flag on the account tracker (renewal at risk: medium-high) until we complete the call and the trial is accepted. :triangle_warning:

Mateo (CS Ops): Logged action items in CS Ops board (#3421). Will attach usage artifacts and the ops-bot export.

Emily (CSM): Thanks team — updates here as we get them.
